  "recovered_c": "uint64_t fn_07(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  if (out_cap < (len + 2) / 3 << 2) {\n    return VERA_ERR;\n  }\n\n  size_t i = 0;\n  while (i + 3 <= len) {\n    uint32_t w = (uint)in[i] << 16 | (uint)in[i + 1] << 8 | (uint)in[i + 2];\n    out[i / 3 * 4] = \"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\"[w >> 18];\n    out[i / 3 * 4 + 1] = \"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\"[(w >> 12) & 0x3F];\n    out[i / 3 * 4 + 2] = \"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\"[(w >> 6) & 0x3F];\n    out[i / 3 * 4 + 3] = \"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\"[w & 0x3F];\n    i += 3;\n  }\n\n  if (len - i == 1) {\n    uint32_t w = (uint)in[i] << 16;\n    out[i / 3 * 4] = \"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\"[w >> 18];\n    out[i / 3 * 4 + 1] = \"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\"[(w >> 12) & 0x3F];\n    out[i / 3 * 4 + 2] = '=';\n    out[i / 3 * 4 + 3] = '=';\n  } else if (len - i == 2) {\n    uint32_t w = (uint)in[i] << 16 | (uint)in[i + 1] << 8;\n    out[i / 3 * 4] = \"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\"[w >> 18];\n    out[i / 3 * 4 + 1] = \"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\"[(w >> 12) & 0x3F];\n    out[i / 3 * 4 + 2] = \"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\"[(w >> 6) & 0x3F];\n    out[i / 3 * 4 + 3] = '=';\n  }\n\n  return i / 3 * 4;\n}"
